heading: Thursday, December 4, 2025
topLine: Google rolls out Gemini 3 Deep Think.

items.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 3 Deep Think
items.summary: Gemini 3 Deep Think is a reasoning mode for Gemini 3 Pro that uses parallel reasoning for complex math, science and logic problems. Google reports 41.0% on Humanity's Last Exam without tools and 45.1% on ARC-AGI-2 with code execution. It is available to Google AI Ultra subscribers.
